$comment: Requirement, acceptance-criterion and operation status from the Phase 2 specification v1.1. tools/phase_status.py combines this file with an evaluator report to print the report's Q1.1 and Q3.1 entries. Check names refer to tools/run_phase3_api_tests.py.

increment.capability: An authorised client can submit any of the six event types, retrieve an interaction's ordered events and status, and check service health; a client holding the reset credential can return the isolated test dataset to an empty state.
increment.users: AI developers and operators, auditors and compliance reviewers, podmate Team 103
increment.provisions: EU AI Act Art. 12(1) (automatic event recording); Art. 16(a) (provider obligations); review events record evidence related to Arts. 14 and 26

AC-03.name: Timeline and warning detection
AC-03.otherEvidence: Phase 4 timeline unit tests and the phase-4-timeline-scenario.json integration test; opt-in evaluator profile --phase4-timeline.

AC-06.name: Storage failure
AC-06.otherEvidence: integration tests test_unreachable_storage_is_safe, test_storage_failure_never_confirms_write_or_reset and test_missing_schema_is_unhealthy in CI

requirements.name: Chronological timeline with missing/out-of-order warnings
requirements.missing: Timeline ordering and missing/sequence warnings are implemented under the provisional Phase 4 dotted-event lifecycle. Pod agreement on lifecycle vocabulary and rule equivalence remains outstanding.

requirements.name: Store duplicates once, reject conflicting event IDs
Record human-review details
requirements.missing: Review events are validated and stored; the audit report that presents review actions (AC-05) is Phase 4.

requirements.name: Reject invalid or oversized input without partial writes
Report unhealthy storage and never confirm unstored events
Preserve accepted events; corrections as new linked events
requirements.missing: No update or delete operation exists and events are stored in managed PostgreSQL; restart persistence was verified locally with the Docker image, and correction links are stored but not checked (Phase 4).

requirements.name: Authorised test reset to an empty state
Reject protected operations without valid credentials
Expose no credentials, stack traces, database details or paths
requirements.missing: Error responses use fixed safe messages; inspecting logs (the human part of AC-09) is Phase 4.

requirements.name: Network-accessible common interface with equivalent cross-team results
requirements.missing: Basic endpoint conformance only; equivalence of warnings and reports with Team 103 is Phase 4-5.

operations.limitation: Warning semantics follow the provisional Phase 4 lifecycle; cross-team rule agreement remains outstanding.
